nodes.label: generate-agent-files.js (next dev AGENTS.md writer)
nodes.rationale: next dev writes and re-adds the agent rule blocks; committing AGENTS.md keeps the working tree clean.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Feedback Reporting
nodes.rationale: Agents retain anonymized feedback candidates (crashes, incorrect behavior, unclear docs, unexpected CLI behavior) during a request and run one reporting pass before the final response; never retain code, logs, paths, secrets or personal data.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (Breaking Changes Notice)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes to APIs, conventions and file structure, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.
